title: Thursday Means Today?  (周四就是今天？)

segments.t: 回到菩提庭院旅馆（Linden Courtyard Inn），格雷厄姆正坐在高脚凳上剥一根新的铜线，这时阿瑟走近前台，为自己刚刚在电话里淘到的所谓“划算买卖”得意洋洋。先完整听一遍这段对话。
Congratulate me, Graham! I found folding wooden garden chairs at half price!
Half price? Why do I already feel nervous when you say 'half price'?
Because the shop only gives that price if you order two dozen at once!
Two dozen?! Arthur, two dozen is twenty-four chairs!
Twelve for Room Nine, eight spares for the courtyard, and four for... emergencies!
Where on earth do we store twenty-four chairs while we paint all week?!
Relax! I told the driver to bring them next Thursday afternoon.
Wait, who just backed a delivery van up to our front gate?
A blue van? Why does the side say 'Garden Chairs Express'?!
Let me read your notepad... boss, you circled 'Saturday two o'clock'!
I read the wrong column without my glasses! They are unloading them now!
Twenty-four wooden chairs in our narrow courtyard. Wonderful, boss!
现在我们来逐句学习对话中的每一句话。
Congratulate me, Graham! I found folding wooden garden chairs at half price!
“恭喜我吧，格雷厄姆！我找到了半价的木质折叠花园椅！” 要表达某样东西只卖平时价格的一半，可以用带 at 的固定搭配：
at half price!
中间不加冠词。
Half price? Why do I already feel nervous when you say 'half price'?
“半价？怎么你一说‘半价’我就开始紧张了呢？” 搭配 nervous 或 tired 这类表示情绪或状态的形容词时，
feel nervous
直接用动词 feel 连接形容词即可。
Because the shop only gives that price if you order two dozen at once!
“因为这家店只有一次订购两打才给这个价！” 注意下面这个表达里的两个细节：
two dozen at once!
其中 dozen 跟在数词后面不加 -s，而 at once 的意思是“一次性、一并下单”。
Two dozen?! Arthur, two dozen is twenty-four chairs!
“两打！？阿瑟，两打可是二十四把椅子啊！” 当把一个数量看作整体数值或数学等值时，这里会用单数形式：
two dozen is
把这一整批当作一个总和来看待。
Twelve for Room Nine, eight spares for the courtyard, and four for... emergencies!
“九号房放十二把，院子里留八把备用的，还有四把留着……应急！” 作为复数名词时，
eight spares
指留存起来以备日后不时之需的备用物品或零件。
Where on earth do we store twenty-four chairs while we paint all week?!
“我们这整整一周都要刷漆，到底把二十四把椅子放哪儿啊！？” 想在疑问句中加强惊讶的语气又不显得粗鲁，可以插入
Where on earth
紧跟在疑问词之后。
Relax! I told the driver to bring them next Thursday afternoon.
“别急！我跟送货员说了下周四下午送来。” 这种间接吩咐的表达采用“人 + 带 to 不定式”结构，见于
told the driver to bring
比用从句表达简洁紧凑得多。
Wait, who just backed a delivery van up to our front gate?
“等等，谁刚把一辆送货车倒到了我们大门栅栏那儿？” 表示倒车操控车辆可以用动词 back：
backed a delivery van up
再搭配 up to 来说明倒车到达的位置。
A blue van? Why does the side say 'Garden Chairs Express'?!
“一辆蓝色货车？车身侧面怎么写着‘Garden Chairs Express’！？” 标牌、车身或标签上印着的文字，在英语里用动词 say 来引出：
Why does the side say
就像中文里我们常说的“上面写着”一样。
Let me read your notepad... boss, you circled 'Saturday two o'clock'!
“让我看看你的本子……老板，你圈出来的是周六两点整！” 名词 circle 也可以用作规则动词，比如在
you circled
中表示在表格或日程本上画圈选定某一项。
I read the wrong column without my glasses! They are unloading them now!
“我没戴眼镜，看错列了！他们现在已经在卸货了！” 前缀 un- 使 load（装货）的动作反转，构成
are unloading
而这里的 read 是过去式，发音与表示红色的 red 相同。
Twenty-four wooden chairs in our narrow courtyard. Wonderful, boss!
“我们这么窄的院子里放二十四把木椅子。真棒啊，老板！” 两打椅子和
narrow courtyard.
之间的反差，为那句冷峻反讽的“Wonderful, boss!”铺垫了语气。让我们再以正常语速完整听一遍这段场景。
Congratulate me, Graham! I found folding wooden garden chairs at half price!
Half price? Why do I already feel nervous when you say 'half price'?
Because the shop only gives that price if you order two dozen at once!
Two dozen?! Arthur, two dozen is twenty-four chairs!
Twelve for Room Nine, eight spares for the courtyard, and four for... emergencies!
Where on earth do we store twenty-four chairs while we paint all week?!
Relax! I told the driver to bring them next Thursday afternoon.
Wait, who just backed a delivery van up to our front gate?
A blue van? Why does the side say 'Garden Chairs Express'?!
Let me read your notepad... boss, you circled 'Saturday two o'clock'!
I read the wrong column without my glasses! They are unloading them now!
Twenty-four wooden chairs in our narrow courtyard. Wonderful, boss!
因为没戴眼镜，阿瑟把二十四把椅子订成了周六两点送货，而不是周四，货车现在已经在门口栅栏外卸货了！等姑娘们回来，看看她们会是什么表情吧。
See you soon!
